description: Generate an image from a text prompt using MFLUX (MLX-native FLUX on Apple Silicon). Returns a public download URL. Synchronous — a call takes a few seconds (schnell/z-image) to a couple of minutes (klein/qwen-image).
name: generate_image

prompt.description: Text description of the image to generate

model.description: schnell (fast 4-step default), z-image (fast turbo), klein (FLUX.2-klein, higher quality), qwen-image (best for legible text/typography in the image), dev

description: Edit an existing image by instruction (qwen-image-edit) or img2img. Provide image_url (a public http(s) URL or an already-uploaded file name) plus a prompt describing the change. Returns a public download URL.
name: edit_image

image_url.description: Public http(s) URL or an already-uploaded workspace file name of the source image

prompt.description: Instruction describing the edit (e.g. 'make the sky sunset orange')

model.description: qwen-image-edit (instruction editing) or another model for plain img2img

strength.description: img2img strength 0-1: how far to move from the source image
